assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game-interface border, a single reusable nine-slice panel frame for an original gaslit mystery roleplaying app. Create one square image, front-facing orthographic. The frame is four straight, narrow rails of dark polished walnut, almost black-brown with a cool tone and fine straight grain, each rail a plain rounded bead moulding with ONE thin continuous strip of polished yellow brass inlaid along its inner edge and a hairline of green baize cloth showing in the rebate beside it. The four corners are plain, tight mitre joints in the walnut, each pinned by a single small flat brass plate. The rails are PLAIN and CONTINUOUS along their whole length: no studs, no rivets, no beads, no repeating ornament, no carving, so they can stretch in a responsive UI. Restrained cabinet joinery of a gentlemen's club: precise, dark, quiet. Material depth, soft cold highlights along the walnut bead and a crisp bright line on the brass so the rails read on both a pale and a near-black green page: the tactile artistic UI craft of a classic strategy game, not a flat vector border. Frame aligned square to the canvas, no perspective. Each rail stays narrow, within the outer 11 percent of the image. BACKGROUND: the large rectangular central opening (the central 76 percent in each dimension) and the thin space outside the frame must be filled with perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta #FF00FF, with no texture, no shadow, no gradient and nothing crossing it, so it can be keyed out to transparency. Frame nearly fills the canvas with a 2 percent magenta outer margin; nothing cropped. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the frame itself. Cool neutral top-left light. No leaves, no vines, no gothic tracery, no warm orange glow, no words, no letters, no numbers, no buttons, no icons, no scenery, no watermark.

Rich hand-painted realistic strategy-game UI art, strong sculpted volume, bright crisp brass highlights with cool reflections, soft cold glow in the glass, so it reads on both pale and near-black green pages. IMPORTANT composition: the top arm occupies only the top 14 percent of the image; the left arm occupies only the left 14 percent. No warm orange glow, no fire, no leaves, no vines, no gothic tracery, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols that look like writing, no frame around the entire image. assets.referencePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production wide landscape banner artwork (3:2, as wide as the tool allows) for an original mystery roleplaying game's lobby. Hand-painted premium strategy-game environment art with atmospheric depth. An unoccupied gentlemen's club reading room that doubles as a private investigator's office, late on a wet night, lit by gas. The DOMINANT colour of the picture is green: a broad card table and a writing desk both topped in rich billiard-green baize fill the lower foreground and the centre; the walls are deep bottle-green damask; a brass desk lamp with an emerald green glass shade stands on the desk at left of centre and throws a cool pale pool on the baize. Dark walnut appears only as narrow trim: the desk edge, a dado rail, the window frame. On the right third a tall sash window streaked with rain; beyond it a fog-bound cobbled street and one iron gas street lamp whose flame burns cold blue-white, haloed in grey fog. Two small brass wall gas brackets with frosted glass globes burn with small blue-white flames. Small polished brass fittings catch the light: a bell push, drawer pulls, a magnifying glass lying on the baize, a closed pocket watch. Light is cold: fog grey, gas-flame blue-white, green reflected from the baize. NO fire, NO fireplace, NO candle, NO warm orange or amber glow anywhere, no cosy tavern feeling. The largest shapes sit in the left and right thirds with a calm open centre of plain green baize and wall so the image reads when cropped to a shallow horizontal band through its middle. No people, no silhouettes, no hats, no pipes, no violin, no paper files, no photographs, no string, no newspapers, no readable book spines, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no door numbers, no clock face numerals, no logos, no UI widgets, no picture frame around the image, no watermark. Entire canvas opaque edge-to-edge scenery. Painterly realism, tactile cloth nap, wet glass, brass highlights.

history: Generated 2026-11-22 for the first Gaslight build, one generation per slot. The night scene was first painted cold (blue-white gas flames) and repainted warm the same day, from that painting, when the comparison that mattered became Unquiet Depths, whose night is cold green-black; the corner glass was relit to match, and unlit for day. Each file was looked at full size and on day and night pages; the corner's round lamp boss was checked mirrored into all four corners. Source PNGs are not in the repository.
